rationale: DFT scan is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='serial_peripheral_protocol' declares LL20 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

fields.notes: JESD204's protocol-level DFT surface is the SYNC~ error path, the ILAS/FCHK, the 8b/10b error monitors (204B) or command-channel/CRC/FEC (204C), and the /A//F/ alignment monitors. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain device-integrator concerns.
fields.ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)

in_band_test_facilities.name: SYNC~ handshake / error reporting
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Controls CGS and reports link errors (204B); primary in-band control/observability.

in_band_test_facilities.name: ILAS link-config + FCHK
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: In-band link configuration with a verification checksum.

in_band_test_facilities.name: 8b/10b error monitors
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Disparity / not-in-table / unexpected-control detection and counters (204B).

in_band_test_facilities.name: Command channel + CRC/FEC (204C)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: In-band status, integrity, and optional FEC.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Per-lane CDR lock and character-alignment status.
out_of_band_test_facilities: Vendor SerDes PHY bring-up / eye-scan tools (implementation-defined).
Vendor device control bus (SPI) register reads for link status.

ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)
